describes: Surface cues for lowering free-text assertions into the fixed 5D, as DATA. A fact is a relation between entities: is-a/part-of -> STRUCTURAL, any other predicate -> RELATIONAL; polarity + quantification ride as edge properties. No nD facet — factual is the 5D floor.

predicate_cues.structural: \b(?:is|are|shall be)\s+(?:not\s+)?(?:a|an|one of(?: the)?|a type of|a kind of|a category of|part of|comprised of|composed of)\b

entity_cues.entity_trail: \s+(?:which\b|who\b|whose\b|to which\b|as referred to\b|referred to in\b|pursuant to\b|adopted by\b|involved in\b|of the (?:main|seconding)\b).*$
